LimitsDefinitionUserFile.description: LimitsDefinitionUserFile defines named shorthand groups that combine existing usage or value flags for reuse in item filters.

usageflags.description: UsageFlags maps shorthand names to groups of usage flags.

user_lists.description: XMLName identifies the required `<user_lists>` document root.

valueflags.description: ValueFlags maps shorthand names to groups of value flags.

LimitsUserBinding.description: LimitsUserBinding maps one shorthand name to the usage or value flags it represents.

name.description: Name is the shorthand identifier referenced from an item definition.

usage.description: Usages are the location-purpose flags included in this shorthand group.

value.description: Values are the loot-tier flags included in this shorthand group.

LimitsUserBindingList.description: LimitsUserBindingList defines shorthand names that expand to several usage or value flags in Central Economy item definitions.

user.description: Users are the named flag groups available to item definitions.

NamedRef.description: NamedRef stores the name attribute used by CE reference elements such as usage, category, tag, value, type, and group.

name.description: Name is the identifier referenced by the containing CE element.
